Chapter 405 Border Demon

At the same time, in the Human Emperor Hall.

A slender and handsome man was standing in the hall with his hands on his back. His youthful eyes were a little vicissitudes, his eyes were staring at the outside of the hall, as if he was about to penetrate the void.

Wu Hui, the contemporary master of the Human Emperor Palace!

A disciple of martial arts.

"District Master, are you going?"

Behind Wu Hui, a subordinate dressed in black asked respectfully.

"Go? Where to go? Go to the Wu family?"

"My dignified Lord of the Human Emperor Palace, now I want to be a puppet that their Wu family will call and wield away?!"

Wu Hui clenched his fist with one hand, then raised his back, and his voice was heavy.

This sentence made the black-clothed subordinate kneel on the ground and dared not say anything.

At this time, it was only a moment before Wu Zhi returned to the Wu family. The person sent by the head of the Wu family to spread the news was still on the way, but Wu Hui, who was in the Human Emperor Hall, had already known everything.

It seems that everything is under the control of this Lord of the Human Emperor Palace.

And at this moment, another powerful man from the Human Emperor Palace came to the hall.

"Lord of the Palace, are you looking for me?"

The person who came was wearing a beautiful white robe with a deep breath and was also one of Wu Hui's confidants.

"Mochou, the Palace Master is back."

"The real master of the Human Emperor Hall."

Wu Hui looked at Mo Chou in front of him and said lightly.

When Mochou heard these two sentences, his eyes widened. Mochou was still a little stunned in the first sentence. Isn’t the palace master right in front of him?

But if it were the real master of the Human Emperor Hall, there would be only one in the entire Chaos Realm.

The first palace master, Lu Xue.

No matter how well the palace master is doing or how solidified his subordinates are, as long as Lu Xue says, Wu Hui will not be able to sit in this position.

This is not only because of Lu Xue's strength, but also because of Lu Xue's identity.

The successor of the Human Emperor, who is backed by the giant Huangcheng, is even more unfathomable.

Thinking of this, Mo Chou sighed slightly. He looked up at Wu Hui, "District Master, are you going to abdicate?"

Upon hearing this, Wu Hui walked out of the hall slowly. Looking at the beautiful mountains and rivers in front of him, Wu Hui said softly, "I can't help it."

"Senior Lu, I am the same person I respect. Master respects her, and I am the same. Besides, the Human Emperor Palace was originally created by her, so what reason do I have to occupy it?"

It can be seen that Wu Hui was very open-minded.

But Mo Chou hesitated, "Then have you been working hard over the years to waste?"

This made Wu Hui silent for a long time. He worked hard for so many years just to protect the Good Man Emperor Palace and prevent the tribe from splitting. But now, what he did seems to be just a joke.

After so many years of hard work, it is not even as good as Lu Xue's words.

Do you regret it? Of course, you don’t regret it anymore.

Just like his name, Wu Xuan, no regrets.

"The Palace Master is back, but he didn't go back here directly."

Looking into the distance, Wu Hui suddenly smiled.

Mo Frown frowned slightly, not understanding Wu Hui's meaning, but Wu Hui understood it in his heart.

Lu Xue is giving herself a chance.

Thinking of this, Wu Hui knew that his opportunity had come.

Although his surname is Wu, he is not from the Wu family after all.

"Come here, order the entire Wu family to be blocked. Without my order, anyone is prohibited from entering and leaving!"

"Also, call the Shadow Clan guys."

"Yes, Lord Lord!"

In an instant, the entire Human Emperor Palace shook.

What followed was a storm that swept the entire human race.

......

After a long time, Lu Xue and her group had arrived at the border of the human race.

The tall and thick city walls stretch for thousands of miles, with no end to see. Outside the border are the mountains that are overlapping, which is the territory of the Heavenly Demon Clan.

Click!

The huge city gate slowly opened, and several powerful humans tied dozens of monsters with special iron chains and walked into the city in a mighty manner.

People laughed and celebrated the harvest this time.

Those monsters are the monsters of the Heavenly Demon Clan.

This place was a desolate place a long time ago, and the human race here could only rely on the border to resist the invasion of powerful monsters.

Now, it is obviously easy to attack and defend.

Lu Xue sighed, and Ao Qing also restrained her sloppy appearance, her expression filled with sadness.

The old man Broken Sword didn't feel that deeply.

As a human race, he naturally stands on the human race's standpoint.

"Miss Lu, these things are just one of the stars in the sky. The strong prey on the weak is the norm in the world. What we can do is to protect ourselves and make ourselves strong enough."

The old man Broken Sword persuaded him.

Lu Xue lowered her head slightly, and she also understood this truth.

However, she still wants to change.

If you don't try, how can you know?

Lu Xue slowly stepped forward, and at this time, the conversation between everyone was heard by her ears.

"These damn monsters are today."

"Hahaha, yes, those monsters used to eat us, which made my ancestors move countless times home."

"You young people are afraid that you don't know anything. These are the status established by our ancestors for us. From now on, our human race will never be bullied again, and these hateful monsters will be taught with blood. them!"

"Well said!"

Slap sex.

Everyone couldn't help but cheer and applaud, while the bound monsters grinned, constantly trying to break free from the chains and roared at everyone.

Lu Xue was silent again.

"My master, let's go."

Ao Qing sighed.

Lu Xue also knew that she couldn't do that.

Lu Xue is not qualified to forgive the past human race for the insults and tramplings.

What the human race can do is to keep getting stronger and no longer make the tragic situation of the past appear.

Afterwards, Lu Xue and his group prepared to leave the border and go to the Tiande Clan.

But at this moment, a commotion made Lu Xue and others pay attention.

Looking closely, I saw several powerful humans surrounding a young man.

To be precise, the boy was transformed into a monster and formed a human race. When he got in, he was obviously discovered.

The boy looked ugly at this time, but even so, he was surrounded by many powerful human races and still maintained a little calmness and calmness.

"That little guy is interesting."

Ao Qing's eyes lit up and he praised him in a rare way.

The old man Broken Sword nodded constantly. He saw a bit of ruthlessness in the eyes of the demon boy that day, and he was definitely not a pampered person.

Lu Xue narrowed her eyes slightly. What she noticed was that the eyes of the demon boy were filled with hatred for the human race that day.

"My little master, I want to save him."

Ao Qing said.

Lu Xue nodded, "Yes, but it's not the time yet, let's take a look first."

"good."

Immediately, Lu Xue and others slowly moved forward, as if they were just passers-by watching the fun.

"Hahaha, I'll say, how could you have the aura of a monster at a young age? It turns out that it's really a monster."

"It will transform at such a small size. It has good talent and can definitely sell it for a good price."

"Don't fight with me. I want to take this little demon home for wine!"

Everyone's words and words were all bad intentions.
